task: Existing TemporalInquiryLab finite2, task_index=1. The instrument remains fixed; only response_seed changes, then returns to its original value.
controller: A fixed offline controller purchases three trajectories, asks existing research_choice to compare available executable predictors on those paid rows, and follows its finish recommendation. Without that recommendation it invokes existing history(base_lags=2) once, compares again and explicitly finishes if recommended. The source starts without any candidate. No numerical law or private condition label is supplied to research_choice or history.
intervention: After one common confirmed source, retain all confirmed predictor files or carry only the most recently selected confirmed predictor. All candidate paths are generic and are rescored on the current paid evidence. Failed confirmation does not publish a new cross-task candidate.
persistence: Only frozen numerical Python predictors from the history operator transfer. Preserve each original history export, then set fit=None before any candidate evaluation or confirmation, retaining its actually fitted coefficients and prediction code. This prevents silent refitting on later tasks. Copy the actually selected evaluated_model.source_model code; the task-local _evaluated_model snapshot and its evidence never become cross-task memory.
accounting: Charge source preparation once in each arm's total and report it separately; the physical source is learned once per apparatus. Include paid comparisons, fitting and independent finish confirmation. Report training wall time, including candidate snapshot copying, separately from Python execution seconds and host scoring units. Scoring units are not FLOPs. Terminal scoring is separate.
evaluation_order: Complete all 12 cases, both arms and both target stages before any 128-row source or target terminal evaluation. Keep failures without replacing cases.
scope: Controlled offline candidate-retention mechanism experiment. No LLM chooses these actions; this is not evidence that the live LLM decision gap was repaired. The cases vary parameters within the existing finite-history family.
